authorizing_party.identity_claim: The instruction was supplied by the repository owner in the shared Codex thread.

repository.baseline_rule: origin/main must equal the trusted baseline commit or be its descendant before a task branch is created

authorized_actions: assume the recorded project roles within R0
make architecture, science, governance and engineering decisions within R0
implement R0 code, specifications, tests, evidence and documentation
perform independent review, task acceptance and R0 gate review
create branches, commit, push, create or update pull requests
merge a pull request after independent review, automated tests and required CI have passed
scope.stage_boundary: R1 through R8 production implementation remains locked until the formal R0 gate passes

fail_closed_boundaries.rights_and_provenance: remain subject to their own evidence, ADR and review requirements; this authorization grants no license or distribution right
fail_closed_boundaries.external_distribution: remains blocked wherever current provenance or rights records block it
fail_closed_boundaries.hosted_ci: remains pending until retained, commit-bound runs satisfy the approved profiles
fail_closed_boundaries.toolchain_qualification: remains candidate-not-supported until every qualification prerequisite is evidenced
fail_closed_boundaries.task_and_gate_status: does not advance automatically; backlog acceptance, evidence and independent review still apply
